maven.//: Used only by the Smithy CLI; under Maven the classpath comes from the codegen module and this module's provided-scope dependencies. AWS_SDK_JAVA_VERSION is set automatically by codegen-maven-plugin; for the Smithy CLI, export it or pass -DAWS_SDK_JAVA_VERSION=<version>.

client.//: Transforms are applied in order. renameShapes is built into Smithy; the other two come from the customization module.

transforms.//: Standard Smithy transform. Region collides with software.amazon.awssdk.regions.Region, so give the modeled shape a distinct name. References to it are updated automatically.
transforms.name: renameShapes

transforms.//: Custom transform. renameShapes only renames shapes, so member renames need this.
transforms.name: renameMembers
